facts.hours: Spring (March 2 - May 31): Tuesday - Friday 10am - 4pm, Saturday - Sunday 10am - 5pm; Summer (June 1 - September 13): Daily 9am - 6pm; Fall (September 14 - November 30): Tuesday - Friday 9am - 4pm, Saturday - Sunday 9am - 6pm (Closed November 26); Winter (December 1 - March 1): Wednesday - Sunday 9am - 4pm (Closed December 25, January 1)
facts.prices: Adults (13+): $26; Youth (3–12): $16; Children (Under 3): Free; Discounts are available for seniors, active duty and military veterans, college students, and groups of 15+.
facts.visit_length: Plan about three and a half hours to explore the exhibition. If you’d like to walk the one-mile boardwalk, allow extra time.

task_check.biggest_fix: Add clear parking instructions alongside the driving directions, and move essential practical details like dining and accessibility higher on the page.

facts.parking: There are 8 ADA accessible parking spaces available within 400 feet of the entrance. Parking surfaces are concrete and the mobility access area aisles are wooden cobbles. The pathways are aggregate paving (not loose surface).

task_check.biggest_fix: Add the recommended 3 1/2 hour visit length so guests with mobility, stamina, or sensory considerations can effectively plan their day.

facts.parking: Free general parking is available on the Library campus, a short walk from the main entrance. Lots accommodate standard vehicles, accessible parking, and drop-off areas for those with mobility needs. Designated oversized vehicle parking areas are provided for RVs, buses, and motorcoaches.
